label: playCheck
js: (() => { const t0 = performance.now(); const r = game.playCheck(); return JSON.stringify({ ok: r.ok, total: r.total, failedCount: r.failed.length, failed: r.failed.slice(0, 30), ms: Math.round(performance.now() - t0) }); })()

label: playCheck.prove (mirror and stuck must both fail)
headless check in the page
js: (() => { const r = game.check(); const f = game.checkFail(); return JSON.stringify({ ok: r.ok, n: r.results.length, failed: r.failed, failVariant: f.ok }); })()
